title: Filtered candidates: FILTER stage output, LLM stage input
description: Every listing the FIND stage returned, annotated with per-filter results. Failures are kept so a run can be audited: you can check why a specific listing did not reach the judge.

topics.description: Keys are topic names defined in the active profile.

status.description: A non-ok status is carried through to the report, so a broken search reads as broken instead of as an empty market.

source.description: Which board this came from. Job ids are namespaced per source so ids never collide across boards.

seen_recent.description: Company appeared in the index inside the dedup window; suppressed so weekly reposts do not dominate.

passed.description: True when every load-bearing filter passed and the listing is not a recent duplicate.

filters.description: Per-filter results. Which of these are load-bearing is set in the profile.
